messages:
Maya R: Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy + webinar plan + benchmark narrative. Need decisions by EOD so we can hand off to ops.
Samir P: Thanks. My notes: tighten the Hosted hero to emphasize 'API-first, low-latency' and move price cues to secondary line.
Alex W: +1. Suggest CTA split — 'Try Hosted' vs 'Compare Dedicated' -> different funnels.
Jamal K: Also need routing for inbound leads. Recommend AE for Dedicated and Private, self-serve for Hosted. Simple rules in #sales-ops.
Olivia T: Draft headline options attached: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency" / "Inference that scales with your app". Which tone do we want? product or reliability?
Maya R: Prioritize reliability for Dedicated/Private; product velocity for Hosted. We'll test hero variants in the next sprint.
Samir P: Webinar plan: "Benchmarks & Real Costs: Serving LLMs in Production" — present hosted vs dedicated tradeoffs, show live Q&A. Date proposals: Apr 18/25.
Alex W: Can the benchmark narrative include example per-token cost comparison for a 10k qps-ish batch workload? Keep numbers high-level.
Jamal K: Yes. Ops will not share raw infra costs. Use normalized units: tokens/second per GPU and relative cost multipliers.
Olivia T: Landing copy mapping for the three modes (short bullets): Hosted: instant API, pay-as-you-go. Dedicated: reserved pools, SLA. Private: VPC + compliance.
Maya R: Good. Include 'fallback policies' line under reliability bullet — that's a differentiator.
Samir P: For lead routing, proposed rule set:
```
hosted -> marketing-qualified -> repo: self-serve-flow
dedicated -> sales-assigned -> AE outreach
private -> enterprise-specialist -> security-sales
```
Alex W: Want the marketing funnel to capture 'use-case' in the form: product, platform, regulated. Add a hidden form field.
Jamal K: Can we add "webinar registrant -> benchmark whitepaper" nurture flow? marketing-bot will automate.
marketing-bot: Reminder: Webinar template updated in Notion: https://redwood.design/notion/webinar-templates :bell: 
Olivia T: For CTAs on each page, propose: Hosted: "Start free"; Dedicated: "Request capacity eval"; Private: "Talk to security".
Maya R: Copy constraints: keep hero under 12 words, bullets 12-18 words. We need final copy by Thursday.
Carly P: Looping in design for hero variants and visual callouts. @design-team can you prepare 3 comps by Wednesday?
Alex W: Also want a small benchmark callout component near the hero: "Median 95ms latency, 5x cost savings vs baseline (typical configs)" — phrasing to legal review.
Jamal K: I'll draft the benchmark blurb and share numbers normalized.
Samir P: A/B test plan: Variant A = product-forward hero; Variant B = reliability-forward hero. Track signups and demo requests.
Maya R: Great. I'll consolidate and post final copy in this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Carly P: Noted — will confirm with design and drop comps in #design-review.
marketing-bot: Event scheduled: Webinar tentative Apr 25 — calendar invite will go out when copy is final.
